title: Star Decompositions of a Cyclic Polygon
summary: Let $V$ be a set of vertices on a circumference in the plane. Let $E$ be a set of directed line segments linking two vertices of $V$. If $E$ forms a set of closed cycles and for all two adjacent edges $uv$ and $vw$, the vertices $u$, $v$, $w$ are arranged in anti-clockwise order, we call $P(V,E)$ a cyclic polygon. A star decomposition $\mathcal{S}$ of a cyclic polygon $P$ is a set of star polygons partitioning the region of $P$ with some additional diagonals.
